_comment: EXAMPLE. Fill in training storms and satellites before running train_qnn_density.py. Feb 2022 (Starlink Group 4-7, launch 2022-010) is held out and must not be trained on. 'ballistic' is Cd*A/m in m^2/kg; the Group 4-7 satellites have no quiet period before the storm, so a justified value is needed there (0.0338 is the ILLUSTRATIVE craft, not a measured value). For other events, null estimates it from the pre-storm element sets.
